method: Qualitative review of live search results for the five topic clusters, inspection of existing Cnvrted articles and learning guides, and primary-source checks for cited claims.
limitations: No keyword-volume, keyword-difficulty, Search Console query export, or ranking forecast was obtained. Targets are editorial hypotheses based on intent and product relevance. Do not present them as proven high-volume or low-competition terms.

existingContent./blogs/what-is-a-gtm-play: Keep as the conceptual GTM-play foundation; new agency article covers implementation.
existingContent./learn/buying-signals: Keep as the broad definition/examples page; new hiring article focuses on reading and verifying vacancies.
existingContent./learn/ideal-customer-profile: Keep as the ICP definition; new qualification article covers individual account decisions.
existingContent./learn/signal-to-outreach: Keep as the product walkthrough; new articles cover working methods and measurement.
existingContent./blogs/apollo-vs-cnvrted: Comparison intent remains separate from the informational guides.

articles.primaryKeyword: how to find first B2B customers
supportingKeywords: first B2B customers using buying signals
articles.intent: Founder wants an executable route from research to a first paid engagement.
articles.originalContribution: A bounded research batch, evidence note, fictional routing-service example, discovery questions, and pilot acceptance criteria.
searchQueries: how to get first customers sales founders

articles.intent: Seller wants to decide which vacancies justify relevant outreach.
articles.originalContribution: Responsibilities-to-question matrix, three fictional account decisions, and explicit counter-evidence such as backfills or bringing work in-house.
searchQueries: B2B first customers buying signals prospecting hiring signals sales agency lead generation
articles.sourceNote: Original recommended workflow, not empirical findings; no vendor conversion claims adopted.

articles.primaryKeyword: how to qualify prospects before cold email
articles.intent: Salesperson wants a defensible contact/research/hold/exclude decision before writing an email.
articles.originalContribution: Four gates instead of a compensating score, queue rules, and an example distinguishing observed facts from unknown budget and timing.
searchQueries: lead qualification BANT need budget authority timeline

articles.intent: Agency owner wants a repeatable way to connect a specific service to a current client need.
articles.originalContribution: Two detailed plays with offer scope, counter-evidence, stop rules, and delivery-team review.
searchQueries: lead generation for agencies outbound playbook
articles.sourceNote: Original fictional plays, clearly labelled; no performance results claimed.

articles.intent: Operator wants to assess whether research effort creates useful sales outcomes.
articles.originalContribution: Stable account-level denominators, a fully worked fictional funnel, research cost allocation, and checks against unfair cohort comparisons.
searchQueries: signal based outbound metrics positive reply rate qualified meetings
qualify prospects before cold email signal based outbound metrics

editorialChecks: No invented results or customer attribution
Cnvrted team byline rather than unreviewed personal authorship
Internal links to relevant guides and companion articles
Unique title, description, canonical, and cover alt
Sitemap inclusion does not mean indexing
afterPublication: Review indexing, actual query impressions and clicks in Search Console, and meaningful product/demo visits. Refine pages from observed queries and user questions; do not assume adding pages causes rankings.
